title: Choir and Veil
author: Bram Almeida
blurb: Theo Reyes, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
